candidates.change_summary: Change the boolean operator from || to && so the interface is only reported as supported when both conditions hold.
Replace the return expression with a constant true so every interfaceId is reported as supported.
Replace the checked interface id with type(IERC165).interfaceId so the AccessControl interface id is no longer reported as supported.
Replace the return expression with the constant true, so every role check reports membership.
Replace the return expression with the constant false, so no account ever appears to hold a role.
Negate the membership lookup so hasRole returns the opposite of the actual membership state.
Return the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE constant instead of the stored admin role for the given role.
Return the queried role itself instead of its stored admin role.
Read the adminRole of the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE entry (effectively zero) instead of the given role's entry.
